thesis: Hold QQQ, IWM, and NVDA. Cash is $0, so any buy is a sale of one of those lines. New pre-open items do not clear that bar. Dimon and Dalio RSVPing to a Saudi summit names no tradeable action, and I will not sell the book to buy JPM on an attendance headline. Chinese tech ties in Saudi Arabia, Florida medical-pot headwinds, and Ukraine's budget warning name no US equity. GCO's Q2 note, margin gains offsetting lower sales, has no open in the tape. Yesterday's '$89 billion reason to buy Nvidia' still has an empty summary and supports keeping the NVDA line rather than selling IWM to add. The unnamed dividend king, BofA's unnamed fintech, SpaceX, Medtronic, Amphenol, and Rezolve still have no open. SPSM-versus-IJR does not touch IWM. Oil and crypto items name no US major. House PTRs are filings only, with no tickers.
